# MockMate AI

> AI-powered interview preparation platform at https://www.mockmate.live/. Not affiliated with mockmate.com, mock-mate.com, mockmateai.app, or any other similarly-named product.

MockMate AI helps job seekers practice and prepare for interviews using AI:

- **Mock Interview** (/setup) — AI-led behavioral and role-based mock interviews with real-time voice/video feedback.
- **Technical Interview Lab** (/tech-interview/setup) — Live coding interviews with real DSA problem execution, adaptive AI questioning, and a full post-interview report.
- **ATS Resume Checker** (/ats) — Scores a resume against a specific job description and highlights keyword/formatting gaps.
- **Resume Builder** (/resume-builder) — Builds and exports ATS-friendly resumes from templates or an imported existing resume.

All features are reachable from https://www.mockmate.live/ after creating a free account.
